instructions:
1. Place a kettlebell on the floor between your feet. Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, toes pointed slightly out.
2. Hinge at the hips and bend the knees to grasp the handle with both hands. Keep your back flat and chest up.
3. Push through your heels and extend your hips and knees together to stand tall.
4. Hinge at the hips and bend the knees to lower the kettlebell back to the floor under control.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive your knees out over your toes, do not let them cave inward.
2. Keep the kettlebell close to your body throughout the lift.
3. Brace your core before each rep to protect your spine.
4. Squeeze your glutes hard at the top.

instructions:
1. Place a kettlebell on the floor between your feet. Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, toes pointed slightly out.
2. Hinge at the hips and bend the knees to grasp the handle with both hands. Keep your back flat and chest up.
3. Drive through your heels and extend your hips and knees to stand tall.
4. As you reach standing, explosively pull the kettlebell up toward your chin, leading with the elbows and keeping them high.
5. Lower the kettlebell back down and return it to the floor under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Let the leg drive feed power into the pull, do not yank with the arms alone.
2. Keep your elbows above the kettlebell during the high pull.
3. Keep the kettlebell close to your body.
4. Brace your core before each rep.

instructions:
1. Stand on two stepboxes with a wide stance, toes pointed slightly out. Hold a kettlebell with both hands so it hangs between your legs.
2. Bend your knees and push your hips back to lower into a wide squat. Let the kettlebell drop into the gap between the boxes.
3. Lower until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
4. Push through your heels to stand back up and squeeze your glutes at the top.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive your knees out over your toes, do not let them cave inward.
2. Keep your back flat and chest up, do not lean forward.
3. Keep your weight on your heels and midfoot.
4. Brace your core throughout the squat.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out, with a kettlebell on the floor about 30 cm in front of you.
2. Hinge at the hips, bend the knees slightly, and grab the handle with both hands. Keep your back flat.
3. Hike the kettlebell back between your legs to load the hips.
4. Drive your hips forward explosively to swing the kettlebell up to shoulder height, keeping your arms relaxed.
5. Let the kettlebell fall and hinge at the hips to guide it back between your legs.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Power the swing with your hips, not your arms.
2. Keep your back flat and do not round your shoulders.
3. Snap your glutes and brace your abs hard at the top.
4. Exhale as you swing up, inhale as it swings down.
